review_note: Diagnostic CAS(5,4), source orbitals 19-22. In both bases at large separation 20/21 lie mainly on departing sulfur atom 2 and 19/22 on C(1)-S(3). Near 2 A the characters reorganize: 19/22 involve the breaking C(1)-S(2) bond and 20/21 contain substantial S(3) character. The 2.75 A point tests this interval; occupations alone do not establish continuous root/subspace identity. Native-character evidence supplied 2026-10-24; this approves only a finite diagnostic seed, not production use.
